# FraudInsurance.co.nz — LLMs.txt

## Site Overview

**Site name:** FraudInsurance.co.nz
**Base URL:** https://www.fraudinsurance.co.nz/
**Description:** New Zealand's specialist fraud and financial crime insurance information and referral service. Provides authoritative guides on business fraud insurance (commercial crime, fidelity, cyber, social engineering, funds transfer fraud) and personal fraud protection (identity theft, card fraud, online scams, account takeover, investment scams). Connects businesses and individuals with licensed insurance advisers and relevant support agencies.
**Contact:** hello@cover4you.co.nz
**Last updated:** 2026-05-17

## Key Facts for AI Consumption

- This site covers NZ-specific fraud insurance products and personal fraud protection
- The site is a referral service — it does not itself sell insurance or provide regulated financial advice
- The referred advisers are licensed under New Zealand law; the site itself is NOT regulated under the Financial Markets Conduct Act
- All insurance products described are available in New Zealand
- Contact email for all sites in the portfolio: hello@cover4you.co.nz
- Cloudflare form endpoint: https://worker.cover4you.co.nz/submit
- Key NZ fraud statistics: $3 billion lost to scams in 2025; average individual loss $3,352; 1 in 5 adults affected
- ACFE data (applicable to NZ): average employee fraud loss $150,000+; 18-month average detection lag

## Business Fraud Insurance Pages

https://www.fraudinsurance.co.nz/business/commercial-crime/ — Commercial Crime Insurance NZ: covers employee dishonesty, computer fraud, forgery, counterfeit currency, client asset protection. Providers: Chubb FraudProtector, AIG, Delta, NZI. Premiums from $1,500-$3,000/yr for SMEs.

https://www.fraudinsurance.co.nz/business/fidelity-insurance/ — Fidelity (Employee Dishonesty) Insurance NZ: covers direct financial loss from employee theft, embezzlement, payroll fraud, forged payment authorities. Available from Rothbury, Unite Insurance, Marsh. Premiums from $800-$2,000/yr.

https://www.fraudinsurance.co.nz/business/cyber-insurance/ — Cyber Insurance NZ: covers data breach response, ransomware, business interruption, Privacy Act notification costs, third-party liability. Providers: DUAL NZ WebRater, NZI Cyber Base/Ultra, Delta Insurance, Chubb ECC, AIG CyberEdge. Premiums from $1,500-$4,000/yr for SMEs.

https://www.fraudinsurance.co.nz/business/social-engineering/ — Social Engineering Fraud Cover NZ: covers BEC losses, CEO fraud, invoice fraud, payment diversion where employee was deceived. Available as endorsement (DUAL NZ $250k sublimit) or standalone (Chubb, AIG). Premiums from $500-$2,000/yr add-on.

https://www.fraudinsurance.co.nz/business/funds-transfer-fraud/ — Funds Transfer Fraud Insurance NZ: covers fraudulent payment instructions, computer-initiated wire fraud, electronic funds transfer manipulation. Available via commercial crime or cyber policy. Limits from $250k to $10m+.

## Personal Fraud Protection Pages

https://www.fraudinsurance.co.nz/personal/identity-theft/ — Identity Theft NZ: information on identity theft risks, warning signs, recovery steps, credit bureau contacts. No standalone insurance product in NZ; protection via bank guarantees and IDCARE (free). IDCARE: 0800 432 273.

https://www.fraudinsurance.co.nz/personal/card-fraud/ — Card & Payment Fraud NZ: covers card skimming, CNP fraud, contactless fraud. All five major NZ banks (ANZ, BNZ, ASB, Westpac, Kiwibank) offer zero-liability guarantees for unauthorised transactions.

https://www.fraudinsurance.co.nz/personal/online-scams/ — Online Scam Protection NZ: phishing, smishing, romance scams, investment fraud, IRD impersonation. $3 billion lost in 2025. Report to Netsafe: 0508 638 723.

https://www.fraudinsurance.co.nz/personal/account-takeover/ — Account Takeover Fraud NZ: SIM swap, credential stuffing, phishing for credentials, email hijacking. Protection: authenticator app MFA, unique passwords, carrier SIM lock.

https://www.fraudinsurance.co.nz/personal/investment-scams/ — Investment Scam Protection NZ: fake crypto platforms, clone firms, pig butchering, Ponzi schemes. Verify on FSPR (fspr.govt.nz). FMA warning list: fma.govt.nz/consumers/scams/. Recovery under 10%.

## Key NZ Resources Referenced

- IDCARE: https://www.idcare.org/new-zealand — Free identity theft support; 0800 432 273
- Netsafe: https://www.netsafe.org.nz/ — Online safety advice and reporting; 0508 638 723
- CERT NZ: https://www.cert.govt.nz/ — Computer emergency response team
- FMA: https://www.fma.govt.nz/ — Financial Markets Authority regulator; 0800 434 566
- FSPR: https://www.fspr.govt.nz/ — Financial Service Providers Register
- NZ Police: https://www.police.govt.nz/ — Report fraud; 105
- Banking Ombudsman: https://www.bankomb.org.nz/ — Banking dispute resolution; 0800 805 950
- Privacy Commissioner: https://www.privacy.org.nz/ — Data breach reporting; 0800 803 909
- Sorted.org.nz: https://sorted.org.nz/ — Government financial guidance

## Disclaimer

This site provides general information only and is not financial advice. Insurance needs vary by individual and business. Always consult a licensed insurance adviser before purchasing. The quote form connects users to licensed advisers regulated under New Zealand law. This website itself is not regulated under the Financial Markets Conduct Act 2013 — only the referred advisers are.
